svg.title: L2 Services -- Streaming data platform
svg.desc: A client submits a job to the Flink JobManager, whose Dispatcher starts a JobMaster for it. The JobMaster assigns tasks to the TaskManagers' task slots, which read events from Kafka topics and write Iceberg tables. Redrawn from the Flink Architecture documentation on apache.org.
